The savory meat pairs well with the aroma of spice in this common curry.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make Poultry Curries by [[Cooking]] a [[Raw Bird Drumstick]], [[Hylian Rice]], and [[Goron Spice]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. When eaten, they will heal some of Link's [[Heart]]s. The savory [[Meat]] in this common dish pairs well with the aroma of Goron Spice. By adding other [[Ingredient]]s to Poultry Curry, several different variations can be made: * '''Chilly Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Poultry Curry}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The savory meat pairs well with the aroma of spice in this common curry.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly Ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Electro Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Poultry Curry}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The savory meat pairs well with the aroma of spice in this common curry.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. When eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Poultry Curry}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The savory meat pairs well with the aroma of spice in this common curry.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. Link's Stamina Wheel will be completely restored and overfilled by eating them. * '''Energizing Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Poultry Curry}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The savory meat pairs well with the aroma of spice in this common curry.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. If eaten, they will refill part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Poultry Curry}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The savory meat pairs well with the aroma of spice in this common curry.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. Consuming them will increase Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Poultry Curry}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The savory meat pairs well with the aroma of spice in this common curry.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. Eating these curries will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts. * '''Mighty Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Poultry Curry}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The savory meat pairs well with the aroma of spice in this common curry.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. Eating them will grant Link a boost to the power of his attacks. * '''Sneaky Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Poultry Curry}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The savory meat pairs well with the aroma of spice in this common curry.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. They can be eaten to increase Link's [[Stealth]] abilities. * '''Spicy Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Poultry Curry}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The savory meat pairs well with the aroma of spice in this common curry.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. These curries can be eaten to grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Poultry Curry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Poultry Curry}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The savory meat pairs well with the aroma of spice in this common curry.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients. Link will gain a boost to his [[Defense]] when he eats these. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Gourmet Poultry Curry * Meal * Prime Poultry Curry }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Curries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
